summary: Remove bounded parent-curve waviness at joins in one glyph and three shared templates, preserving branch endpoints and historical hooks.
diagnosis: The remaining visible bumps in U+3D7B7 arise from parent bowl waviness. Adding legs 6 and 8 produces zero upper-edge ink in the two inspected join windows in all five native and compiled weight cases.
policy: Repair only independently reviewed bounded parent windows. Preserve all other strokes, branch endpoints, closed flags and authentic terminals.
